parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=2.2 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 2.2 µF p.2 vs TLV70033DDCR: 1 µF p.13); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TLV70033DDCR is rated to only 5.5 V rec. (6 V abs max, p.5) vs AP2204K-3.3TRG1 at 24 V rec. (38 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 150 mA (p.5) compared to TLV70033DDCR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 360 mV p.5 vs TLV70033DDCR: 175 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TLV70033DDCR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6 V, p.5) than AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (38 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.6 V (p.4) vs 2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TLV70033DDCR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2204K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP2204K-3.3TRG1 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TLV70033DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; Vin,max rating drops >=20%; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.8 °C on AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 250 °C/W) vs 60.2 °C on TLV70033DDCR (θJA 235.9 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.6x ratio (20 µA (p.5) vs 31 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 "Severe 24 V High-Voltage Thermal Derating in SOT-23-5 (θJA = 250 °C/W Limits Load < 20 mA)" (p.4) and TLV70033DDCR "VEN Must Never Exceed VIN + 0.3 V (Sequencing Trap vs TPS7A02/TLV755P)" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose AP2204K-3.3TRG1 when input rails climb above 5.5 V (rated to 24 V); choose TLV70033DDCR when load current exceeds 150 mA (up to 200 mA) or low Vin-Vout headroom requires 175 mV dropout. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
